title: AstralytiQ — No-Code Forecasting & BI
impact: Cut a 5-hour manual reporting cycle to ~10 minutes across 40+ SKUs
description: Upload sales data, clean and explore it, and generate ARIMA/XGBoost forecasts with interactive dashboards — no code required. Automated the full ETL-to-cloud pipeline.

title: Release Copilot — AI DevOps Agent
impact: Runs a software release end-to-end without a human in the loop
description: Reads what changed on GitHub, flags risks, files Jira tickets, ships to Netlify, and publishes a release report to Notion — every API call flowing through one integration layer.

title: Feedline — Food-Delivery Backend
impact: Production patterns: modular monolith with a designed path to microservices
description: A food-delivery backend built in Spring Boot with clean architecture, real-world domain modeling, and scalability as a first-class concern.

title: RegIntel — Compliance Intelligence
impact: Turns RBI/SEBI/NPCI circulars into measurable action points with deadlines
description: Extracts and chunks regulatory PDFs, embeds them into ChromaDB, and uses Gemini-powered RAG to convert raw regulation into actionable compliance plans.

title: NutriSync — AI Nutrition Assistant
impact: Cultural food intelligence for Indian dietary patterns, not a generic calorie counter
description: A voice-first Flutter app with personalized meal recommendations built around how India actually eats — regional cuisines, home cooking, and local ingredients.

title: ShastraLab — UPSC Answer Evaluation
impact: Examiner-style feedback on handwritten and typed civil-services answers
description: Evaluates UPSC answers for structure, relevance, depth, and examiner expectations, with visual mentoring for aspirants who lack access to good coaching.
